per_object_cap.stated: 150 MB per episode file: Acast sets the internal limit to 150MB, in line with Apple's 150MB cellular download limit; MP3 and M4A only

egress.terms: Free distribution to all major platforms; no egress charge. Acast monetises via ads, not storage.

tooling: Dashboard only; no public upload API.
chaining: 5 episodes x 150 MB = 750 MB per free account in the honest reading; N accounts. Not interesting at scale.

limits_note: 150 MB hard per-episode cap — 'Acast sets the internal limit to 150MB also', and going over produces an 'episode unavailable' error on listener devices because Apple caps cellular downloads at 150 MB. MP3 or M4A only (no WAV/FLAC).
reliability_note: Re-encodes to 128 kbps: 'Acast will encode your uploaded files at 128kbps, which will not impair the perceived quality for your listeners.' Two independent caps (150 MB, 5 episodes) plus a 128k transcode make this the weakest of the majors.
